credits.title: Collision Course
credits.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

credits.title: Another League
credits.overview: Spain, the 1970s. Although Francoist ideology remains deeply entrenched in society, a group of young trailblazers and an ambitious promoter are about to change the history of women’s football.

credits.title: From Good to the Hood
credits.overview: Cheating the tax man was just too tempting for Andrés. Besides, what are the chances of him getting caught? Well, as it turns out, pretty high! And that’s exactly what happens when a couple of tax inspectors turn up at his company to inform him that he owes the IRS a lot of money.

credits.title: The Champion
credits.overview: Diego has just been voted best young player in Europe and at the age of 20 he is on his way to making his team, Atlético de Madrid, champions of La Liga. credits.title: Siege (Asedio)
credits.overview: During an eviction procedure in a troubled area of Madrid, police officer Dani makes a shocking discovery.

credits.title: Among-Terrestrials
credits.overview: Mari, a housewife who is unsatisfied with her life, feels a strong devotion to aliens. One night, she goes to the countryside to sight UFOs and discovers a devastating revelation concerning her marriage. Fed up, Mari decides to look for love beyond Earth.
